channel.title: slack-datamine-plus daily changes
channel.description: Daily summary of what changed in Slack's web client bundle.

item.title: Mining now includes the client entry scripts (one-time additions, build 76531814a11d)
item.description:
The miner now also crawls the client's entry scripts (the legacy web client: modern.vendor, application, rollup-core_*, TS.web), which it never read before. Everything below was already in the client; it was not found until now. These are one-time additions, not reported value by value. Names are matched as strings in the code, so a hit means the client mentions it, not that it calls it.

  • api-methods: 936 names were already tracked but marked absent; the client does mention them (1,553 now found, up from 617)
  • experiments: 1,215 experiments (1,199 with group names), mined for the first time
  • ui-strings: +17,757
  • enums: +714
  • errors: +442
  • workflow: +247
  • design-tokens: 421, new category
  • notification-types: +101
  • icons: +81 names (the glyph set itself is in icons.pdf)
  • paths: 81, new category
  • shortcuts: +80
  • slash-commands: 46, new category
  • dev-commands: 22, new category
  • trace-spans: +29
  • analytics-events: +10
  • feature-flags: +12
  • ai-enums: +16
  • blockkit-enums: +9
  • hosts: 9, new category

The 73 methods that were never tracked before are new to this list; the rest were present in the client all along.
